g.text: Check boolean MinVelTogether

g.title: j1020393654
g.text: MomToxicated: I can't help but wonder what Neci would think if she knew we were stuck here.

g.title: j803793093->j1020393654
g.text: true

g.title: j2677791855
g.text: MomToxicated: I can't help but wonder what Neci would think if she knew we were stuck here.

g.title: j803793093->j2677791855
g.text: false

g.title: j4020913742
g.text: PapaPolar: i hope she'd be happy to see we'd settled our issues.

g.title: j1825306006
g.text: PapaPolar: probably come back just to put us out of our misery.

g.title: j624083450
g.text: Yeah... who knows. [End.]

g.title: j2832332496
g.text: Did she know you two had fallen apart?

g.title: j1888733057
g.text: MomToxicated: Wouldn't blame her.

g.title: j3469037119
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j3589123309
g.text: MomToxicated: She was perceptive. More than most. More than we'd trained her to be.

g.title: Chat ends. Next chat will be MinVelRank5Convo2.
g.text: Chat ends. Next chat will be MinVelRank5Convo2.

g.title: j3469037119->Chat ends. Next chat will be MinVelRank5Convo2.
j1560915255
g.text: PapaPolar: the last time we spoke to her was on a secure line.

g.title: j2324432063
g.text: PapaPolar: and that weird lookin' little grease weasel of hers was probably listening in

g.title: j3866606018
g.text: PapaPolar: at that point we were still *technically* together, but things were going south, fast...

g.title: j3199307315
g.text: MomToxicated: I'd bet good money she knew. She could hear it. Even if we didn't know it at the time.

g.title: j3963073496
g.text: Could you tell if she was... y'know. "Him" yet?

g.title: j3212418395
g.text: What did you three talk about?

g.title: j28920835
g.text: PapaPolar: she sounded like our little girl, if that's what you're asking. knew what to say and how to say it.

g.title: j1052226903
g.text: MomToxicated: It started off business. How she was handling command. She couldn't give us numbers, or details, of course.

g.title: j4263845362
g.text: MomToxicated: But all good hostage takers know how to make their captive birds sing on command.

g.title: j2983404726
g.text: MomToxicated: We weren't Scaldra. Nothing more than civvies, to the people on the other end of the line. So she couldn't be giving us classified intel.

g.title: j1794532776
g.text: MomToxicated: That doesn't mean anything about when, or how, this "Indifference" took her.

g.title: j917251947
g.text: PapaPolar: but she sounded... stressed. you could hear it.

g.title: j3947132261
g.text: MomToxicated: Or who was driving her body when we spoke to her that day.

g.title: j4227352580
g.text: Her? Stressed? Hard to imagine.

g.title: j3243859303
g.text: Stressed about what?

g.title: j18458673
g.text: PapaPolar: i don't know how one finds a god and punches it in the [REDACTED] face but i'm gonna [REDACTED] try

g.title: j3381987380
g.text: MomToxicated: Heh. Happens to the best of us. Especially when you're chasing a "fugitive."

g.title: j1596134739
g.text: MomToxicated: A "fugitive."

g.title: j421162357
g.text: MomToxicated: Entrati. At the time, I figured it was "just" a local drug lord or resistance leader.

g.title: j3162416730
g.text: PapaPolar: barely even mentioned the freakin' monster toaster tv zombies. you'd think that would've come up more.

g.title: j99878159
g.text: MomToxicated: I wonder if she had lost her arm yet at that point. No way to know, I suppose.

g.title: j2093833345
g.text: How'd you end things?

g.title: j2026769781
g.text: Did you tell her you were coming to Höllvania?

g.title: j361825443
g.text: MomToxicated: The way spies always end phone calls. By lying to each other.

g.title: j3105755325
g.text: PapaPolar: lol. hells no. city was under lockdown, remember? total covert ops, us sneaking in.

g.title: j670314707
g.text: MomToxicated: We told her we'd be going on a mission somewhere else, when we were planning on deploying into her locked-down city.

g.title: j2851134631
g.text: MomToxicated: We ended the call the way spies always end phone calls. By lying.

g.title: j49702938
g.text: PapaPolar: and then we both told each other the biggest lie of all.

g.title: j724431383
g.text: PapaPolar: we all said "don't worry, we'll be fine."

g.title: j3841602862
g.text: MomToxicated: At least we did tell her one last truthful thing before we hung up.

g.title: j3403325113
g.text: PapaPolar: yeah. we did.

g.title: j1723370509
g.text: Oh?

g.title: j1817063463
g.text: Which was?

g.title: j2134117546
g.text: PapaPolar: "You're our baby girl. And nothing will ever change that."

g.title: j3556020
g.text: MomToxicated: "We'll always love you, no matter how far away you go."

g.title: j848113030
g.text: I'm sure she still knows that, no matter what's really happened to her.

g.title: j1171434991
g.text: She was lucky to have you both as parents.

g.title: j1779951525
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j211198773
g.text: PapaPolar: thanks.

g.title: j3751085603
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j425371406
g.text: MomToxicated: I hope you're right.

g.title: j425371406->Chat ends. Next chat will be MinVelRank5Convo2.
